name: Fylhas Do Dragão
description: Fylhas Do Dragão is a techno event taking place at Pérola Negra in Porto. The lineup includes Aníbal, DJOOKE, Deepneue, ONIO, and DJ GIOVANNA.
longDescription:
Fylhas Do Dragão is a techno event scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at Pérola Negra in Porto. The party starts at 11:59 PM and runs until 6:00 AM.

The lineup features Aníbal and DJOOKE performing a b2b set, along with Deepneue from Berlin, who will also play a b2b with ONIO. DJ GIOVANNA is also part of the night's performers. Tickets are available starting at €7.00.

O cartaz apresenta Aníbal e DJOOKE num set b2b, juntamente com Deepneue de Berlim, que também fará um b2b com ONIO. DJ GIOVANNA também faz parte dos artistas da noite. Os bilhetes estão disponíveis a partir de 7,00€.
